historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved the plans, elevations and estimated cost, about $152,000, of a neighborhood playground with a clubhouse near Hahn Street and Visitacion Avenue, presented for Hans U. Gerson of William Gladstone Merchant & Associates, the architects engaged in April (Resolution 4799) through the Department of Public Works; it was paid for from the 1955 playground bond fund.

The playground was dedicated as the Francis J. Herz Playground, for the Recreation and Park Commissioner, at a ceremony set for Saturday morning, November 27; in December the Commission had letters of thanks from Dr. Herz and from Visitacion Valley clubs for naming the recreation center for him.
